audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Aurora Level 3 and the 2+ item stage, contradicting whys[2] ("Even window") and whys[6] ("out-sustain and out-DPS you at 2 items").
audit.why: Illaoi is the scaling side of this lane once the tentacle field is stacked; the packet chart already reads Aurora / Aurora / Skill / Skill / Aurora / Skill / Illaoi.
audit.corrected: Aurora / Aurora / Skill / Skill / Aurora / Skill / Illaoi, ratings adjusted to match. diff stays EVEN at 50.85%.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns anywhere and Level 6 names "Between the Worlds".
audit.why: Aurora's ultimate is Between Worlds (140/120/100s). Test of Spirit is 16/15/14/13/12s at 900 range — the same reach as your Twofold Hex. Harsh Lesson is a 4-second leap. Leap of Faith is 120/95/70s but only 450 range, so it is a walk-out, not a chase.
audit.corrected: Real name and numbers now in phases, breakdown.cooldowns, loading and the report.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page gives the single most dangerous piece of advice on the matchup backwards. content.early says "the second you see the cast, use W to leap straight out of her tentacle field", and wants.you[2] repeats it. Running away from your ripped spirit is exactly what turns you into a Vessel.
audit.why: Riot's text for Test of Spirit: "If killed, or if the target gets too far from the spirit, the target will become a Vessel and begin spawning Tentacles." Leaping clear satisfies the distance condition. The correct play is to stay within range of the spirit while stepping out of tentacle reach, and to protect the spirit rather than abandon it. Two further corrections: Prophet of an Elder God says Tentacles swing at spirits, Vessels and victims of Harsh Lesson — so if you avoid E and W, the field does not auto-attack you at all, which is why the lane is playable; and Harsh Lesson is a 4-second auto-reset leap, so the wind-up is the tell, not the cast. Finally the page claims Between Worlds makes you untargetable in five places — Riot gives it a damaging slow shockwave and a slow zone she can teleport across; the invisibility belongs to Across the Veil.
audit.corrected: Vessel condition stated correctly; tentacle targeting rule and Harsh Lesson's reset added; untargetability reassigned to Across the Veil.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal appears only once, in a line that calls Illaoi "his".
audit.why: Prophet of an Elder God heals her whenever a Tentacle damages a champion, so Grievous Wounds is the item that decides extended trades.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal now tied to the passive by name in phases[2] and the breakdown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Illaoi is called "him"/"his" in breakdown.mid, wave, trading, feeding, late and report[8]; and the "KA answer / a immobile drain bot" template line appears four times.
audit.corrected: Pronouns and the template line replaced.

The cardinal rule is her E, Test of Spirit: if she rips your spirit, do NOT walk through her tentacles to chase it, so the second you see the cast, use W to leap straight out of her tentacle field. Last-hit from Q range; never step into her auto-plus-tentacle range to trade.

The cardinal rule is her E, Test of Spirit: you become a Vessel if the ripped spirit dies OR if you get too far from it, so do NOT leap away — step sideways out of tentacle reach while staying close to the spirit. Last-hit from Q range; never step into her auto-plus-tentacle range.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 you control spacing with Q pokes and your E slow-and-hop disengage, but she's stacking tentacles and her passive sustain is climbing, so this is genuinely even — you poke, she heals off slams, neither snowballs unless someone mispositions. At 6 you tilt it your way: when she commits Leap of Faith or a Test of Spirit, drop Between Worlds and use its empowered spirit mode to go untargetable, walk out of the whole tentacle field, and her ult value evaporates. Only stand and fight her on open ground away from her tentacles.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 you control spacing with Q pokes and your E slow-and-hop disengage, but she's stacking tentacles and her passive heals off every tentacle hit, so this is genuinely even — buy Grievous Wounds and neither of you snowballs unless someone mispositions. At 6 you tilt it your way: when she commits Leap of Faith, drop Between Worlds to slow and zone her and use Across the Veil's invisibility to leave the tentacle field, and her ult value evaporates — it only reaches 450. Stand and fight only on open ground away from her tentacles.

edits.before: This is her lane to reclaim. Once she has 2+ items and a full tentacle field, standing to fight is suicide — her tentacle slams and Test of Spirit out-sustain and out-DPS your poke, and your W/R only buy escape, not a kill. Use R's untargetability to dodge her all-in and your spirit-walk to splitpush or roam, but never duel her on her own field. Bank the leads from your early-mid windows and let your team collapse on her in fights, where she's immobile and easy to peel away from her tentacles.

notes: The highest-severity error in my whole slice: content.early and wants.you[2] told the player to leap away the moment Test of Spirit is cast. Riot's text says the target becomes a Vessel "if killed, or if the target gets too far from the spirit" — the page's advice causes the exact outcome it is trying to avoid. Also removed the Between Worlds untargetability claim (five places) — the invisibility is Across the Veil. NOTE ON A BAD DERIVED FLAG: the kit file tags Leap of Faith with "grounding" and "untargetable", but Riot's own description for it is only "smashes her idol into the ground, dealing physical damage to nearby enemies. A Tentacle spawns for each enemy champion hit." Per the calibration rule I trusted the description and did not write any grounding or untargetability interaction for her R — worth checking whether that flag is misfiring on other Illaoi pages too.
